name: std::copyable

declarations.code:
template <class T>

concept copyable =

    std::copy_constructible<T> &&

    std::movable<T> &&

    std::assignable_from<T &, T &> &&

    std::assignable_from<T &, const T &> &&

    std::assignable_from<T &, const T>;

intro: The concept copyable<T> specifies that T is a movable object type that can also be copied (that is, it supports copy construction and copy assignment).
